result: If I had the power to change the world in one major way, I would instill a deeper sense of empathy in every person. Genuine empathy fosters greater understanding, kindness, and respect—qualities that could guide how we address virtually all of our biggest challenges, from conflict and inequality to environmental issues. With empathy as a shared foundation, people tend to listen to each other more deeply, appreciate diverse perspectives, and work together toward fairer solutions. Such a shift wouldn’t solve every problem overnight, but it would fundamentally change the way we cooperate, innovate, and care for one another, giving humanity its best chance at lasting progress.
